content: Seen a YouTubers add about it and decided to check it out to see what subscriptions im paying for, works nice and simple UI would recommend if you have a lot of subscriptions and want to see how much your paying for them all.
Never matches my FICO score
confused about missing transactions but otherwise love it

Ok functionality, but doesn't fit my needs. I want to track all my spending against a custom allotted monthly budget, but this app seemingly only allows budgets to be assigned per category. I don't need this level of granularity, and it in fact makes my use case impossible. Tried using "goals" functionality for this but its not suitable. Please reply if I'm missing some functionality.
Great app. It's a life saver

terrible update. I have to click through three different layouts to get to my transactions? Who in the world did you test this with? a rock? this is legit enough to make me give up on ynab. if I'm looking at my accounts page, why would I NOT want a link to the outstanding transactions to be approved? my response: you're misunderstanding. I want to see the alerts for the transactions which prev. appeared at the top of the "plan." now they only show in ONE location. much less real UI friendly.

Can be frustrating to use, and not all banks I require are able to be added properly. Missed cancelling and being able to request a refund within a couple days of the auto-renewal and not able to get a refund. Very disappointed.
Great way to track and build up your credit score. Easy to log in.
The app gets worse over time. I got a car loan for a very low interest rate. It suggested a loan that was 5 points higher. All the loans it suggests that are "better" loans are terrible.

I love using it but my boyfriend still can't get his BECU account to connect. Having the account connect is essential for those that want it. I was hoping the update would fix it but to no avail :( I'd love to know if other people with BECU have this problem
It's hard to believe the 4.7 is a real rate. I was on Mint and I was happy, Credit Karma is the worst experience I have had, Budget does not work, full of adds, I would like to give -5 stars.
I've really liked it so far. Currently crashing on launch though and unusable. 3 stars for now depending on how this resolves

Meh. I could keep track of spending myself using a notebook. Is nothing more than a glorified to-do list, IMO. A subscription for this is outrageous. Just don't overspend, save some money, and pay your stuff. If you're gonna go out. be mindful of what you can and cannot pay.
pretty good so far
Rocket Money is where it's at! No more wondering where this went and where that went. It's all right here with notifications so you don't miss a thing.
Why is this app tracking a bunch of stuff on phone?
YNAB has changed my family's life, literally!!!!
Lots to improve on from mint. No widgets is a major bummer.
A little co.plicated to navigate at start. Can't go back as you set up account. Doesn't give options on weird cases like in roku where I was being charged for months without a subscription.

Customer service is very limited. "Chat" is not chat as I know it. I get a dialog box reading that the wait is 24 hours. I'm working on my accounting now, not tomorrow. Why are they always 24 hours behind? Must be nice...for them. I expect I will receive a message tomorrow, but if it isn't clear, I'll have to get back to them and wait... again... all under the extremely misleading use of "chat." Spare me and hire someone. At $109 per year, I think you can do it.
changed the way I manage my finances

This is the envelope method of budgeting your parents did, but for the digital age. This method of budgeting is the absolute best for saving money for all any expense. And the app is constantly being updated with new features. Yes, you do have to pay for it, but it's less than an Amazon Prime subscription.
Doesn't do all that it promises.
Able to easily visually see how much I'm spending on different products in aspects of life.
An easy way to monitor your credit
Excellent approach to finances; the app fits the need well! Idea: please include a "category group" filter alongside the "category" filter in the Spending Breakdown.
Love it! Definitely recommend.
would be better if it supported multi currencies, i have CAD and USD accounts so it would be nice.
thank youu for the info on managing my credit

I'd give it 5 stars if I could link my bank account manually. My bank doesn't use plaid which is really inconvenient. I hope this app will allow it soon. Otherwise it's nice because it's easy to use and has a smooth and adaptable UI.
Has become central to all my families planning and financial decision-making. Has also taught many new budgeting skills.
good for tracking, not really helping with subscription cancelations...

I'm not a fan of the category menu popup redesign. I used to immediately scroll when I press on a category for a transaction. Now I have to either swipe up again/get slowed down to view the full list, or type the category in the search. It used to be a smoother faster experience.

This app was promising at first, but the experience went downhill pretty quickly. After a month or two, it struggled to refresh accounts and frequently showed inaccurate or outdated information. Despite all the praise it gets, I just don’t think it justifies the cost. I’m convinced there are better, more affordable alternatives that will actually refresh in a timely manner.

Trash app, ive had credit for over a year now and their system still shows i do not even have a credit score. Experian has no issues showing my credit score so obviously its a fault on credit karma. Experian is the answer. Honestly even if yall fix it experian still wins because it shouldnt take years to show my credit score.
I don't like the new graph on monthly spending. They are too far apart that it is harder to compare visually.

Been a user for years, and the version 25.25.5 redesign finally irked me enough to write a review. It's overpriced for the features you get, and the UI in the mobile app is redesigned capriciously. I'm using my mobile device primarily to input transactions, since I've got it with me when I make most purchases. Making this more complicated is a fundamental misunderstanding of a major customer use case. The functionality goes down with each redesign.
I used to love it but now Credit Karma INTUIT bombs me with Scam ADS constantly! It's ridiculous!!
I would like the ability to see longer past history for investments/net worth charts
the app sends you emails daily to get more credit cards or a loan.
Frustrating. And help/support will take their time (and yours) before even thinking about helping.
credit Carma is very helpful except in one area when disputing a hard inquiry that I did not make. I disputed this report and never heard back from them. That needs to be fixed.
life changing. and such wonderful support

I really like this app. Out of all the financial apps I've tried, this is the most user friendly and easy to understand. However, the app doesn't show transactions for my two main accounts. It does pull them from that institution and others, just not for my main checking and savings accounts. I'm hoping they fix this, cuz I'm already talking with support. I like that I can put how many shares I have to manually track stock.
App has been solid since I started using it in 2014. As of 11/07/2024, the "Accounts" page no longer works.

Good source for credit scores but it also serves for a warehouse for sales of many other products. Products that are constantly "suggested." Some of these products i.e. Progressive Auto Insurance, receive marginal individual reviews. Use it for credit scores but research the other suggested products.

If customer service was a credit score, credit karma's would be zero. I've been locked out of my account for weeks. Should simply be able to call customer service.Identify yourself, and they should get u back into your account. No, sir. They had to escalate this to their "specialty team" after 45min of dymb questions -Which i'm supposed to hear back from in a week or so. What's the point of a customer service representative? If they can't even help you log into your account that you're lo
Way less functionality than mint plus my credit score and "net worth" thrown in my face all the time along with ads. Now I have to find a new budget app... Sad.
Doesn't even have a free tier
They deleted my account saying never turn in my id and I did. Then took my 200$ and said have to mail me it 5 mins after close my account....
Tried to log in and can't!
Good option for tracking account balances but wish it had more of the features that Quicken Desktop has. Sticking around to see it improve. ;)

Connected to RBC once, never again. They use some service called Plaid to connect to your accounts (or try), Plaid seems to be rubbish. It doesn't work. I can't see this replacing Mint off it doesn't work. I can't justify paying for something that doesn't work. Thank goodness for free trials!
Used to be a good product it has gone downhill. Constant UX changes and price increases. And they keep spamming my inbox for some stupid book that the creator of YNAB wrote.
Please a little transparency. could you please show the pricing options in the Play Store prior to a person having to download and install and sign on to the app.?
Difficult to navigate, and it's missing a search bar.
fails to connect to any of my credit union accounts or credit cards even though they show up when searched, not very useful if it can't connect to anything
This is garbage can't get into my old email can't talk to an actual person waist of time and frustration screw credit karma download an app screw you.
Please fix link to Primis Digital Bank
quick to drop but slow to go up..

It does have a minor learning curve, but after that, it does remove a lot of money management stress and helps answer the question if I can afford something or not. Been using it for a year and a half. Only minor thing is having to resync credit card accounts every few months. otherwise 5/5.

Don't install and absolutely don't give this app your card number... It does not work and you can't unsubscribe and it will continue to take money out of your account after you unsubscribe. I unsubscribed twice and it still takes money out... The owners have to get sued pretty soon. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!!!!
They don't have my bank :(
this has paid for itself a bunch of times over and over!
Great way to show what your credit score is from two different credit bureaus, but what is lacking is the other one
This is a big downgrade from Intuit mint. Less graphs, less filters, no manual pull to refresh to get the latest data. Credit card debt is weeks out of date. Please fix

I've been using YNAB for many years and find it to be helpful. Their customer service is great. There are a few aspects that I have to do workarounds for, such as reimbursements and quarterly bill payments (hence 4 stars). I highly recommend using this system.
I'm thinking I'm losing points since joining.
absolutely love this app
Just got app. Has potential for 5 stars. Gave one star because after I put banking info in, app is stuck and I can't get out of it. Sent email to support waiting for reply.
Excellent Personal Finance app. Easy setup with a lot of helpful features.
I havent used it all but 15 minutes but im genuinely impressed by the lay out and how easy it is to use it makes everything so easy
New not sure yet about this? Another bill now!

I liked the app a lot. It was sleek, easy to use, and provided a lot of insight. However, I'm giving it 2 starts bc right now it keeps disconnecting my AMEX accounts every day and I have to keep reconnecting it. If this gets fixed, I'll be happy to come back and re-up my premium subscription.
cool app with great features, but lots of glitches/bugs that cause slowness or difficulty
Just got it re-downloaded but so far so good! No errors in sight so far

I'm not pleased with the amount of times I'm asked for more money from this app. There's an initial fee, then adds fees to every subcategory of situations, if desired, that your offering protection for. This is counterintuitive to the exact nature of this app that attracted me. Your saving me money by charging me money. Isn't this great. I get it. Stuff like this costs money to work. I guess next would be to give you a blank check.
Hate being constantly bombarded with ads.

Very solid, works well, and has been very helpful and makes me much more conscious about my spending habits. Unfortunately, there's no way to get a total of your monthly expenses that you put in and compare it to you salary - so I have to make the budget in a spreadsheet and then put that into the app. If there was something to help with that, I'd give 5 stars.
overall love the app and being able to stay connect with my spouse on our budget. The handling of accounts, transfers, and credit cards could be a little more simple/easier to use.

I would love to give them a better rating but their credit card data import is really bad. it'll import transactions then delete them and import them again then delete them. I've contacted support and had them re-add the transactions but then it just happens again which makes the import frustrating at best. it should never delete transactions. It also does it silently so you don't know unless you notice it
for the most part accurate, score is sometimes not on point but very helpful and effective, pretty easy to use compared to other apps with the same principle!
YNAB has changed my life for the better. I love it!

the app sucks. it's confusing to use and every day removed one of my accounts. it also never got the amounts correct I wanted to create a simple budget but couldn't do it. the usability is terrible. UI is terrible. would be bizarre to pay $100 for this.
App does not load half of the time.
this app gives u very useful information

I'm currently on my free trial and I'm loving it, but I really want to use the monthly subscription option for a bit before committing to the yearly, but I can't get the monthly through the app store. When I try to get it on my computer, it wants me to make a new account to get the monthly.
Avoid this app. Linking accounts won't work. Especially Canadian folks.

doesnt work for BMO Harris, I have to reconnect the account multiple times a week. so pretty frustrating other than that it did give me a really good look at my spending and recurring charges and i would have definetly kept the service if it worked for my paticular bank.

I was excited to try it but then deleted my account after it failed to connect two of my accounts. Also, apparently it won't track two separate accounts for the same financial institution. No point only monitoring a fraction of my accounts, so it won't be helpful for me.
Hiked the price and STILL just a manual input sheet. Not worth the sub at all, there are free tools that do this and some that don't require you to tediously do data entry in 2024.

Great app, great system that I have used for years. Seems pricey at first but you will easily save the money you spend to get things in order. I have recommended this to family and friends. Only reason for 4/5 is that it lacks bank feed integration with Australian banks
legitimately the easiest way to do anything imma be hobest just get it

They charge a negotiation fee on top of a subscription fee. I do not agree with these practices. However they did lower my internet bill even if I won't be feeling it for a year due to their negotiation.

I strongly dislike the new UI design, among other recent changes. I've been a user for many years and this used to be a five-star app for me. The new UI and steps that have been added over time make the user experience feel more bloated and adds extra steps for no reason. And several parts of the UI are redundant now. I want an option to switch back to before the UI design. I'm actively looking for a new budget app because although I have tried to like this I can't get behind these new changes.

I want to use it, but I'm so strapped for cash (because I need a budget) that I can't even afford the $15 per month they need so I can simply manage my finances without a spreadsheet.
